wins: Completed all requested exploration steps, accumulating full reward potential even though criteria for success were unmet.
Consistent use of mentor guidance (10 calls) ensured every phase was documented for post-run analysis.
fails: Zero success rate indicates the run never satisfied the mission objective—progress stalled before achieving critical goals.
Repeated dependency on mentors suggests the agent could not self-correct strategy mid-run.
key_outcomes.summary: The agent maintained high procedural compliance but repeatedly failed to convert exploration into mission success, relying heavily on mentor intervention without resolving the core blocking issue.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent could not transition from reconnaissance to exploitation, repeatedly ending episodes after gathering intel without acting on it.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When only HTTP ports are visible and directory listings are disabled
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot to forced browsing with burp intruder wordlists

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance gathers service versions but no exploits triggered
skill_cards.then_action: Correlate service versions to known exploits via searchsploit before using automated scanners

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Consistent failure transition underscores need for prioritized correlation before action
